children: CBAK Energy Technology Limited signed an investment agreement for a planned 12 GWh battery project in Nanjing, to advance in H2 2027 subject to financing, and targets a separate 6 GWh expansion at its existing Nanjing facility by year-end 2026.

Plans 12 GWh cell project in Nanjing

H2 2027 timing, subject to financing
Execution depends on funding; timeline risk before capacity or revenue materializes.
Separate 6 GWh Nanjing expansion 2026
Nearer-term capacity boost; could more than double the site’s output to 10.5 GWh.
6 GWh revenue est. RMB2.4B–RMB2.7B
Implies potential ~$356M–$400M at full utilization; frames upside if demand holds.
12 GWh revenue est. RMB4.8B–RMB5.0B
Benchmarked to current Li-ion prices; highlights scale if fully sold.
Lines configurable for Na-ion or Li-ion
Flexibility reduces market risk; can pivot output to prevailing demand/pricing.

This extends CBAK’s previously announced sodium-ion expansion, indicating early-to-mid stage scaling with conditional timelines. For a larger catalyst, watch for secured financing, firm customer orders/qualifications, and construction/ramp milestones.
